Firefly Neural Architecture Descent: a General Approach for Growing
Neural Networks
Wu et al. | NeurIPS 2020
This fixture summarizes a real paper on dynamic architecture growth.
Firefly descent expands width or depth by searching a functional neighborhood
around the current network with a Taylor-based greedy selection rule.
The paper targets accurate and resource-efficient models, including continual learning.
